english.title: Fail to take animals not intended for immediate slaughter w/o delay from border inspection post to holding

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to take

(A)_[an animal]_
(B)_[animals]_

not intended for immediate slaughter, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL(S)..), without delay from the border inspection post to the holding of destination, namely **(..SPECIFY DESTINATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 8(3) of Schedule 2 to and regulations 39 and 42(2) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
failed to convey animals w/o delay
from the border inspection post to the holding of destination

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies to elephants and to cattle, pigs, sheep, goats and all other animals of the taxa artiodactyla, and their crossbreeds
(ii) See separate offence under paragraph 8(2) in relation to 'animals intended for immediate slaughter' - H18130
(iii) For an offence committed on or after 14/12/19, please see offence wording document H20665

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
